decision: fixed the caveman trailing-newline defect at the root

decision: found the test suite had codified the defect

decision: fixed the report picking the newest receipt instead of the strongest
why: a later discovery drive that only saw a command registered could overwrite an earlier drive that saw it fail, so a real failure could be masked by a weak pass
evidence: independent audit on gemini-3.8-flash flagged the discovery receipts; coverage-report.mjs pickReceipt now ranks failed above verified above the unobserved states

decision: made receipts declare whether they observed discovery or behaviour
why: a discovery receipt proved only that a command exists, and the row's claim was that it does something, so the veto was never exercised
evidence: independent audit finding; lib/receipts.mjs scope field, build-surfaces.mjs classifies by claim, coverage-report.mjs enforces
result: verified count fell from 305 to 253 and 69 rows are now partial, which is the correction

decision: refused to default a missing scope to behaviour
why: 285 receipts predate the field, and grandfathering them would reopen the exact hole the change closes
evidence: receipts on disk: 285 with no scope, 57 behaviour, 5 discovery
result: re-issuing the evidence by re-running every scenario instead

decision: bound every receipt to the scenario text that produced it, and measured the gap
why: F-009 said a receipt can be made to lie by editing its scenario, and nothing detected it. Measuring it is the only way to know how much of the evidence is still proof
